children: Hashdex Nasdaq CME Crypto Index ETF’s earnings rose year over year, driven by a $125.5 million net realized and change in unrealized gain on crypto assets, compared with $16.5 million a year earlier; the Trust also recorded $145,585 in staking income.
² Reported as “NET INCREASE (DECREASE) IN NET ASSETS RESULTING FROM OPERATIONS”.
: Fair value of the Trust’s crypto assets was $498.2 million at Sept. 30, 2026, including bitcoin at 73.79% of net assets.
: Staking income totaled $145,585; $141,364 was allocated to the Sponsor Share and $4,221 to the Trust.
: The Trust issued 10.69 million Common Shares and redeemed 310,000 in the quarter.
: NAV per Common Share was $21.27 at Sept. 30, 2026, versus $30.89 a year earlier.
